componentViews.label: Performance momentum
componentViews.description: How the cohort’s recent daily profit compares with its own 90-day distribution. 50 means dead-on its usual run rate.
componentViews.sentence: The cohort averaged $3.2M in daily profit over the past week, above its 90-day average of $1.1M.

componentViews.label: Breadth
componentViews.description: The share of active cohort wallets that are profitable over the past week. Answers whether gains are broadly shared or concentrated in a few wallets.
componentViews.sentence: 573 of 803 active cohort wallets are profitable over the past week.

componentViews.label: Participation
componentViews.description: How much the cohort is trading versus its 90-day median. A ratio of 1.0 maps to 50, so baseline activity reads as neutral.
componentViews.sentence: The cohort is trading at 1.33× its median daily pace, at 614,915 fills a day against a 90-day median of 462,650.

componentViews.label: Capital conviction
componentViews.description: Net capital the cohort is deploying into positions (buys minus sells), against its own 90-day distribution.
componentViews.sentence: Net capital deployed averaged $29.5M a day this week, below the 90-day average of $31.5M.

cohortStatement: 1,000 parity-verified wallets · market makers excluded · updated daily
